## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (92%)** · Confident · Read in turn
- Tier-1 simulated frozen section with single-class conformal set, high reliability, and clear margins [F9].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 92%, Normal 8%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Strongly favors Benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (10% alpha, 90% coverage) | Single class in set |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 46th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical, reliable input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (60%), 2/5 Normal [F5] | Benign and Normal neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 6, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.86 contribution), 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+0.34 contribution), 19/20 AI spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Typical (-0.20 contribution), 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 7, 8, 11) · context · 11% (93rd percentile) [F7]; 2–3 neoplastic nuclei/region · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (3-region deletion drop +0.0114; 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197 excludes 0).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal stromal invasion exists in regions 7 or 11 (validated invasion scores 1.09, 1.00).
- Tissue is Normal (8%; 2/5 neighbors, `BACH_0090` 92% similar) or inferior margin (81%) is involved.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 11**: Exclude invasion where scores peak (1.09, 1.00) with 93rd-percentile immune infiltrate.
2. **Regions 6, 9, 10**: Confirm benign lobules directly; normal-lobules concept is Unreliable (0/20).
3. **Regions 10, 11**: Check inferior margin segments reaching 51% and 81% probability.
